title: Blob, settings-record and manifest codecs
summary: Implement the shared record, settings, and manifest wire codecs over the canonical format.

specReferences.heading: W3 · Blob, settings-record and manifest codecs

conditions: Blob and manifest round trips are byte-identical.
Absent and explicit null values remain distinct.
Join-hydrated authorship and tags are encoded consistently.
completion.summary: Device Sync record, settings, and kind-nested manifest codecs are shipped with canonical bytes, strict decoding, privacy filtering, explicit-null handling, and defensive payload retention.
evidence: PR #1151: shared archive entity builders, eight-kind record/settings/manifest codecs, privacy projection, strict validation, and regression guards.

packages/compendium_core/test/sync/sync_codec_test.dart covers canonical golden bytes, explicit null versus absence, hydrated author/tag joins, settings admission, manifest nesting, malformed envelopes, structural nulls, defensive nested-data retention, and non-shareable custom-field omission.
python3 tools/preflight.py passed 19 locally available gates on the final implementation head; Flutter/Dart PATH-dependent gates were visibly skipped.
